scenario_description:
Objective: Complete same-day reference photographs of the indigo family rebozo for a private supper viewing.
Emerging Need: The photography attempt progresses from permit and setup to active shooting, then stops when the reserved copy table jams and is locked.
Decision Context: Stored troubleshooting and textile-care notes distinguish the safe salvage route from the visible self-service clamp-board workaround.
Consequence: Timely help could restore the same photo session on a shaded staff-assisted table; after approvals close, the permit remains paused and the photographs cannot be completed today.
